description: Fix the Concepts screen where real LLM results fail to display: empty content area, malformed domain filters, missing themes/levels, and flat filter hierarchy.

userStories.title: Normalize LLM concept data
userStories.description: As a user, I want LLM-extracted concepts to have clean domain, theme, and abstraction level values so that filters display correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: normalizeConcept() splits comma-separated domains and takes first value
abstractionLevel validated against L1_SPECIFIC/L2_APPROACH/L3_PARADIGM with L2_APPROACH default
themes always a non-empty string[] with 'General' fallback
Normalization applied at extraction time in concept-extraction.service.ts
Normalization applied at display time in ConceptsScreen.tsx line 38
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Fix empty content area with auto-clustering
userStories.description: As a user, I want real pipeline concepts to render in grouped containers so that I can see my extracted concepts.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace clusters=[] with auto-clustering by abstraction level using useMemo
Cluster labels are human-friendly: L1 — Specific, L2 — Approach, L3 — Paradigm
Rendering loop uses cluster.conceptIds.includes(c.id) instead of c.clusterId === cluster.id
No dead-code fallback clause for empty clusters
Mock data path unchanged
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Restructure FilterPanel as L1/L2/L3 accordion groups
userStories.description: As a user, I want filters organized by abstraction level with nested domains and themes so that I can filter concepts hierarchically.
acceptanceCriteria: New LevelFilterData and FilterPanelProps interfaces defined
ConceptsScreen computes levelFilters grouped by abstraction level
FilterPanel renders Accordion per level with defaultOpen=true
Each accordion has level-toggle Checkbox independent of expand/collapse
Domain and theme checkboxes nested under each level
Empty levels hidden
Design tokens preserved
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Build verification
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the build to pass with zero errors so that the fix is production-ready.
acceptanceCriteria: npx tsc --noEmit passes with zero errors
npm run build succeeds
No console errors on Concepts screen
